name: What flooring materials are best for rental properties?

mainEntity.name: What flooring materials are best for rental properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Durable and easy-to-maintain flooring options are ideal for rental properties. Popular choices include luxury vinyl plank (LVP), laminate, and ceramic tile. LVP and laminate offer good resistance to wear, scratches, and moisture, making them suitable for high-traffic areas. Ceramic tile is exceptionally durable and waterproof, often chosen for kitchens and bathrooms. Carpet is less common due to its shorter lifespan and difficulty in cleaning between tenants, but can be used in bedrooms for comfort. The best choice balances cost, durability, and aesthetic appeal for the specific rental unit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury vinyl plank (LVP), laminate, and ceramic tile are popular for rental properties due to their durability and ease of maintenance. These options withstand high traffic and resist wear effectively.
